memory_ids.description: Exact memory ids to propose deleting. Use an empty array to ignore id filtering. Search memory first if unknown; delete only when the user asks or the memory is clearly obsolete. The backend validates accepted proposals.

tags.description: Tags that memories must all contain to be deleted. Use an empty array to ignore tag filtering.

scope.description: Scope filter for deletion. Use all to include all visible memory; in a Discord thread, all defaults to thread-only memory.
